question: Should this protected Google Meet test-harness refactor be accepted after an area owner confirms that shared builders preserve every previously distinct browser and lifecycle assertion?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human judgment, and the available context is insufficient to independently establish that the large test-only consolidation preserves all scenario semantics.

options.title: Review the refactor against prior assertions
options.body: Have a Google Meet test-area reviewer compare the shared builders with the removed case-specific setup and merge only if each distinct lifecycle and browser-contract assertion remains covered.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: If semantic comparison is difficult, retain only small independently reviewable deduplications and leave sensitive lifecycle cases explicit.

recommendation.title: Review the refactor against prior assertions
recommendation.body: Have a Google Meet test-area reviewer compare the shared builders with the removed case-specific setup and merge only if each distinct lifecycle and browser-contract assertion remains covered.
